name: Tender Braised Baby Leeks (White & Light Green Only)
whyItWorks: Young leeks trimmed of tough dark green tops, gently braised in mild chicken broth until meltingly soft. Mild, sweet allium flavor with softened soluble fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim root base and discard all tough dark green foliage. Split white stalk lengthwise, rinse silt thoroughly, and simmer in broth with olive oil covered for 20 minutes.
